name: Lightning Bolt
text: LIGHTNING BOLT Lightning Shoot a lightning bolt from your square in a straight, non-diagonal line for a number of squares equal to this spell's energy. The bolt deals 3 magical lightning damage to all wizards and creatures it passes through each time it passes through them. If the bolt strikes an object that blocks movement, such as a wall, it reverses direction, re-entering its current square, and keeps moving. If a wizard or creature suffers any damage from this spell, it becomes stunned for 1 turn.
